name: C1 — Advanced
description: Operate in Mandarin for business, academic, and journalistic contexts. Argue a position, structure formal discourse, and use 成語 with confidence.

guide.intro: Business Mandarin lives in a register far above everyday speech. The same idea you'd say with 因为...所以 over coffee gets dressed up with 鉴于... 因此 in a meeting. Three habits define the register: connectives that tie clauses together, nominalized topics with 至于, and a default to 您 / 贵 honorifics.

sections.text: Formal causal connectives

Casual Chinese uses 因為 X 所以 Y. In formal writing and meetings, you upgrade to 鑑於 X，因此 Y ("in view of X, therefore Y") or 由於 X，故 Y ("owing to X, hence Y"). 因此 and 故 are interchangeable for "therefore", but 故 sounds bookish.

rows.source: 鑑於市場環境的變化，我們因此調整了戰略。
rows.pinyin: Jiànyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, wǒmen yīncǐ tiáozhěng le zhànlüè.
rows.translation: In view of market changes, we have therefore adjusted our strategy.

rows.source: 由於成本上升，公司因此決定提價。
rows.pinyin: Yóuyú chéngběn shàngshēng, gōngsī yīncǐ juédìng tíjià.
rows.translation: Owing to rising costs, the company has accordingly decided to raise prices.

rows.source: 因為成本上升，所以我們漲價了。
rows.pinyin: Yīnwèi chéngběn shàngshēng, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhǎngjià le.
rows.translation: Because costs rose, we raised prices. (casual)

sections.text: 然而 vs 但是 — "however"
但是 works in any register. 然而 is the formal cousin you reach for in reports, op-eds, and presentations. 不過 sits in between — written Chinese friendly but not stiff.

rows: Strong contrast in essays, news, reports.

sections.text: 至於 — topic shift

至於 X ("as for X") moves the spotlight to a new sub-topic and is heavily used in structured talks. The phrase always introduces a fresh clause and is followed by a comma. Think of it as the spoken equivalent of a slide transition.

rows.source: 營收方面我們超出預期。至於成本，仍需進一步控制。
rows.pinyin: Yíngshōu fāngmiàn wǒmen chāochū yùqī. Zhìyú chéngběn, réng xū jìnyībù kòngzhì.
rows.translation: On revenue we exceeded expectations. As for costs, they still need to be controlled further.

rows.source: 至於您提到的合作方式，我們下週再深入討論。
rows.pinyin: Zhìyú nín tídào de hézuò fāngshì, wǒmen xiàzhōu zài shēnrù tǎolùn.
rows.translation: As for the form of cooperation you mentioned, let us discuss it in depth next week.

sections.text: 貴 — honorific prefix

貴 ("honored") attaches to nouns referring to the other party's affiliations: 貴公司 (your company), 貴校 (your school), 貴姓 (your honored surname). Use 貴 anywhere a respectful tone is owed; in return, refer to your own side with the humble 敝 (敝公司 "my humble company") or simply 我方 ("our side").
Mixing registers will make you sound off. Once you open a meeting with 貴公司, stay in formal mode: keep using 您, swap 但是 for 然而, and lean on 至於 for transitions.

lessons.title: Opening a meeting
lessons.description: Greet, thank, and frame the agenda

exercises.prompt: What does "承蒙貴公司的支援" (chéng méng guì gōngsī de zhīchí) mean?
exercises.answer: Thanks to your company's support
exercises.explanation: 承蒙 is a formal "thanks to / kindly receiving"; 貴公司 is the honorific "your company".

exercises.prompt: Build "Today's agenda mainly covers three items"
exercises.answer: 今天 的 議程 主要 包括 三 項 內容

exercises.prompt: the formal opener to its function

pairs.right: Thanks for taking time to attend

pairs.left: 請允許我做個簡單的介紹
pairs.right: Allow me to make a brief introduction
Let's begin with item one on the agenda
I hope we can reach consensus today

exercises.prompt: "貴公司" is the formal way to say ___
exercises.answer: Your company
exercises.explanation: The 貴 honorific elevates references to the other party.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal opener?
options: 感謝各位撥冗出席今天的會議
感謝大家抽空來開個會
感謝各位撥冗出席這次破會
尊敬的各位嘉賓，歡迎蒞臨
exercises.answer: 感謝各位撥冗出席這次破會
exercises.explanation: 撥冗出席 is formal; 破會 ("crap meeting") is dismissive slang. The casual second option is internally consistent; the third option mixes a stiff opener with a slur. The other two stay in register.

exercises.prompt: the meeting role to its Chinese title
Build "Allow me on behalf of the company to extend a warm welcome to everyone"
exercises.answer: 請 允許 我 代表 公司 對 各位 表示 熱烈 的 歡迎

exercises.prompt: Tap the honorific pronoun you hear
exercises.answer: 請問您貴姓
exercises.explanation: 您 (formal) versus 你 (neutral) is the C1 register dial. 貴姓 ("honored surname") only pairs with 您.

exercises.prompt: Which transition best opens the agenda after greetings?
options: 下面我們進入正式議程
exercises.answer: 下面我們進入正式議程
exercises.explanation: 進入正式議程 ("enter the formal agenda") is the standard transition. The others either drop register or sound dictatorial.

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal opener: "今天的會議主要 ___ 三項議程" (mainly covers)
exercises.answer: 包括
exercises.explanation: 包括 ("includes") is the neutral choice. 涉及 ("touches on") and 圍繞 ("revolves around") also work depending on emphasis.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the tight schedule today, please make your remarks concise"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 今天 時間 緊迫 ， 請 各位 發言 儘量 簡短

exercises.prompt: Which is the closest near-synonym distinction at C1?
options: 我認為 (current view) ≠ 我以為 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.answer: 我認為 (current view) ≠ 我以為 (mistaken prior view)
exercises.explanation: 我以為 implies the speaker has been corrected. 我認為 is a current claim. Mishearing one for the other inverts the message.

lessons.title: Negotiation language
lessons.description: Soften, push back, propose terms

exercises.prompt: Which phrase most diplomatically rejects a proposal?
options: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
exercises.answer: 恐怕這個方案我們難以接受
exercises.explanation: 恐怕 ("I'm afraid") + 難以接受 ("hard to accept") softens the rejection while staying firm.

exercises.prompt: Build "On the price issue we hope you can reconsider"
exercises.answer: 在 價格 問題 上 我們 希望 貴方 可以 再 考慮 一下

exercises.prompt: What does "雙方各讓一步" (shuāngfāng gè ràng yí bù) suggest?
exercises.answer: Each side makes a concession
exercises.explanation: Literally "both sides each yield one step" — classic negotiation phrasing for a compromise.

exercises.prompt: "我們的底線" (wǒmen de dǐ xiàn) means "our ___"
exercises.answer: Bottom line
exercises.explanation: 底線 = bottom line, the lowest acceptable terms.

exercises.prompt: the negotiation move to its Chinese phrase
Pick the supplier-negotiation phrasing that signals a willingness to compromise without giving up leverage:
options: 在數量上我們可以讓步，但單價必須維持
你們說什麼我們都同意
這個條件我們絕對不接受，不用談了
exercises.answer: 在數量上我們可以讓步，但單價必須維持
exercises.explanation: Concede on volume, hold the unit price — classic negotiation move expressed in formal Mandarin.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of the long-term partnership, we are willing to make appropriate concessions on the payment terms"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 長期 合作 關係 ， 我方 願意 在 付款 條件 上 做出 適當 讓步

exercises.prompt: Tap the formality marker you hear in the negotiation reply
exercises.spokenText: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
options: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
現在我們想你們再考慮一下
目前我們希望你方再考慮一下
exercises.answer: 目前我們希望貴方再考慮一下
exercises.explanation: 目前 (formal "currently") + 希望 (formal "hope") + 貴方 ("your honorable side") all align in register. Listening for 現在/目前 and 你方/貴方 catches register at speed.

exercises.prompt: What does "達成共識" (dá chéng gòng shí) mean?
exercises.answer: Reach a consensus
exercises.explanation: 達成 ("reach") + 共識 ("shared understanding") — standard meeting outcome language.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "雙方在主要條款上已經 ___ 共識" (have reached)
exercises.answer: 達成
exercises.explanation: 達成共識 / 達成協議 — fixed business collocations.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我覺得這個價格太貴了" into formal supplier-negotiation register?
options: 我方認為該報價偏高，希望貴方能予以調整
你這個價格也太貴了吧
exercises.answer: 我方認為該報價偏高，希望貴方能予以調整
exercises.explanation: 我方 / 該報價 / 予以調整 are all formal upgrades of 我們/這個價格/改一下.

lessons.title: Formal email & letters
lessons.description: Salutations, body, and sign-offs

exercises.prompt: the email element to its position

pairs.left: 茲就貴公司提出的方案，回覆如下

exercises.prompt: What does "茲" (zī) mean in formal email?
exercises.answer: Hereby / herewith
exercises.explanation: 茲 is a classical-style word still used in formal correspondence to mean "hereby".

exercises.prompt: Build "Attached please find the contract draft, please kindly review"
exercises.answer: 附件 是 合同 草稿 敬請 查閱

exercises.prompt: "此致 敬禮" closes a Chinese formal letter, equivalent to ___
exercises.answer: Sincerely
exercises.explanation: Standard formal sign-off; literally "to here, salute".

exercises.prompt: What does "敬請查閱" mean in a formal email?
exercises.answer: Please kindly review
exercises.explanation: 敬請 ("respectfully request") + 查閱 ("check / read") — fixed honorific request.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this formal email body:
options: 茲就貴公司提出的方案，我方回覆如下
茲就貴公司的提案，我方答覆如下
茲就你們那個方案，我方回覆如下
關於貴公司的方案，我方答覆如下
exercises.answer: 茲就你們那個方案，我方回覆如下
exercises.explanation: 茲/我方 are classical-register formal; 你們那個方案 is colloquial pointing language. Mixing them sounds jarring; the other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal email line "In view of the contract you provided, we hereby reply as follows"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 貴方 提供 的 合同 ， 茲 回覆 如下

exercises.prompt: the email element to its Chinese standard line

pairs.right: 主題：關於合同條款的回覆
茲就貴公司提出的方案，回覆如下

exercises.prompt: Tap the salutation register you hear
exercises.answer: 尊敬的王總您好
exercises.explanation: 尊敬的 + 您 = consistently formal. The 你/您 swap downgrades register; 親愛的 sounds personal; 啊 is colloquial.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "麻煩你看一下" into formal email language: "敬請 ___"
exercises.answer: 查閱
exercises.explanation: 敬請查閱/審閱/過目 are interchangeable formal requests for the recipient to read.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence appropriately confirms attachment delivery in formal register?
options: 附件中是合同草稿，請貴方審閱
我把合同貼在下面了，看一下
exercises.answer: 附件中是合同草稿，請貴方審閱
exercises.explanation: 附件中 + 貴方 + 審閱 = formal alignment. The other three slide into casual or commanding tone.

lessons.title: Discussing performance
lessons.description: Numbers, growth, projections

exercises.prompt: "營收同比增長百分之十五" means revenue grew ___
exercises.answer: 15% year-over-year
exercises.explanation: 同比 specifically means "compared with the same period last year". 環比 = quarter-over-quarter / period-over-period.

exercises.prompt: Build "This quarter's profit is significantly higher than expected"
exercises.answer: 本 季度 的 利潤 遠 高於 預期

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
"扭虧為盈" describes a company turning ___
exercises.answer: Loss into profit
exercises.explanation: 扭虧為盈 (niǔ kuī wéi yíng) — a fixed business expression for becoming profitable.

exercises.prompt: Tap the comparison metric you hear
exercises.answer: 同比增長百分之十五
exercises.explanation: 同比 (year-over-year) and 環比 (period-over-period) sound and look alike but mean different things. Train your ear to hear 同 vs 環.

exercises.prompt: the KPI term to its meaning
What does "營收同比增長百分之十五，環比下降百分之三" mean?
options: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
Revenue rose 15% this quarter and 3% next quarter
exercises.answer: Revenue rose 15% year-over-year but fell 3% quarter-over-quarter
exercises.explanation: Mixed-direction comparisons in earnings are routine. 同比 = vs same period last year; 環比 = vs prior period.

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of falling profit margin, the company is therefore strengthening cost control"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 利潤率 下降 ， 公司 因此 加強 成本 控制

exercises.prompt: Tap the figure you hear
exercises.answer: 營業額突破十億
exercises.explanation: C1 listening trains your ear for big numbers. 十億 = 1 billion; 一億 = 100 million; 十萬 = 100,000.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "本季度淨利潤 ___ 上季度增長百分之八" (compared with last quarter)
exercises.answer: 較
exercises.explanation: 較 X 增長 Y is the formal earnings-report frame. 比 also works in neutral register.

exercises.prompt: Which forecast hedge is the most cautious?
options: 我們一定超額完成目標
我們應該可以完成目標
exercises.answer: 我們有望完成目標
exercises.explanation: 有望 ("there is hope") is the standard analyst-grade hedge. 一定 / 必將 are over-confident; 應該可以 is conversational.

exercises.prompt: the financial trend phrase to its meaning

lessons.title: Closing & follow-up
lessons.description: Wrapping the meeting and confirming next steps

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you all for your valuable input"
exercises.answer: 感謝 各位 提出 的 寶貴 意見

exercises.prompt: Which best translates "We'll follow up by email next week"?
options: 下週我們再用郵件跟進
exercises.answer: 下週我們再用郵件跟進
exercises.explanation: 跟進 ("follow up") is a borrowed business term in modern Chinese.

exercises.prompt: the closing phrase to its meaning

pairs.right: Looking forward to working together again

exercises.prompt: "雙贏" (shuāng yíng) means a ___ outcome
exercises.answer: Win-win
exercises.explanation: 雙贏 is the modern business calque from English "win-win".

exercises.prompt: Build "In view of recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO"
exercises.answer: 鑑於 近期 市場 波動 ， 公司 因此 暫緩 上市

exercises.prompt: What does "會議紀要將於會後一週內發出" mean?
options: Meeting minutes will be issued within a week after the meeting
The meeting will end within a week
Minutes are due before the meeting
The meeting will be held weekly
exercises.answer: Meeting minutes will be issued within a week after the meeting
exercises.explanation: 會議紀要 = meeting minutes; 會後一週內 = within a week after the meeting; 發出 = send out.

exercises.prompt: the contract-signing phrase
Build "Both parties confirm the contract will take effect on the date of signing"
exercises.answer: 雙方 確認 合同 自 簽署 之日 起 生效

exercises.prompt: Which closing line best reflects "a successful, win-win meeting"?
options: 今天的會議非常圓滿，期待與貴方達成長期合作
今天就到這吧，下次再說
exercises.answer: 今天的會議非常圓滿，期待與貴方達成長期合作
exercises.explanation: 圓滿 ("perfectly concluded") + 期待 + 長期合作 = polished closing register.

exercises.prompt: Tap the follow-up plan you hear
exercises.spokenText: 下週三我們以郵件形式跟進
options: 下週三我們以郵件形式跟進
下週二我們以郵件形式跟進
下週三我們以電話形式跟進
下週三我們以會議形式跟進
exercises.answer: 下週三我們以郵件形式跟進
exercises.explanation: C1 listening tests fine details: 三 vs 二, 郵件 vs 電話 vs 會議. 以...形式 is formal "by means of".

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal close: "如有任何疑問，請隨時與我方 ___" (contact)
exercises.answer: 聯絡
exercises.explanation: 聯絡 (contact) and 溝通 (communicate) both work; 聯絡 is more standard.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence transforms casual "我們之後再說吧" into proper meeting close-out?
options: 至於剩餘事項，我們將在下次會議中進一步討論
exercises.answer: 至於剩餘事項，我們將在下次會議中進一步討論
exercises.explanation: 至於 fronts a sub-topic; 剩餘事項 / 進一步討論 are formal upgrades of 剩下的事 / 再說.

turns.answer: 另一方面

turns.text: 明白了。下週提案務必把這兩點寫清楚。

我下週會寫得很清楚的啦。

guide.intro: Academic Chinese is dense, nominalized, and emphasis-heavy. Two structures dominate: 是...的 to spotlight one component of an established fact, and nominalization with 的 / 来说 / 而言 to package whole clauses as topics. Master these and your writing instantly sounds academic.

sections.text: 是...的 — emphasis on a known event

When the listener already knows the action happened and you want to highlight when, where, how, or who did it, wrap that element in 是...的. The 是 sits before the highlighted phrase; 的 closes the sentence.

rows.pinyin: Tā lái le.
rows.translation: He came. (neutral statement)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì zuótiān lái de.
rows.translation: It was yesterday that he came. (when)

rows.pinyin: Tā shì cóng Běijīng lái de.
rows.translation: It is from Beijing that he came. (where)

rows.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì èr líng yī bā nián chūbǎn de.
rows.translation: This book was published in 2018. (focus on the year)

sections.text: 是...的 only works for events the listener already accepts as fact. If you're announcing fresh news, use 了 instead — 是...的 would sound oddly defensive.
Nominalization with 的話 / 來說 / 而言

Academic writing turns clauses into topic NPs. 對 X 來說 / 對 X 而言 means "as far as X is concerned". 就 X 而言 raises the formality further. These structures let you front a scoped premise before delivering an argument.

rows.source: 對發展中國家來說，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰。
rows.pinyin: Duì fāzhǎn zhōng guójiā lái shuō, qìhòu biànhuà shì jùdà de tiǎozhàn.
rows.translation: For developing countries, climate change is a huge challenge.

rows.source: 就經濟效益而言，這個方案最為合理。
rows.pinyin: Jiù jīngjì xiàoyì ér yán, zhège fāng'àn zuì wéi hélǐ.
rows.translation: In terms of economic benefit, this plan is the most reasonable.

rows.source: 如果按這個標準的話，我們都不合格。
rows.pinyin: Rúguǒ àn zhège biāozhǔn de huà, wǒmen dōu bù hégé.
rows.translation: If we go by this standard, none of us qualify.

sections.text: Hedging your claims
Academic Chinese hedges constantly. 似乎 (it seems), 可能 (possibly), 在一定程度上 (to a certain extent), and 總的來說 (generally speaking) are the four pillars. Stack them to soften strong claims.
Citing and quoting

rows.pinyin: Gēnjù Wáng jiàoshòu de yánjiū…
rows.translation: According to Professor Wang's research…

rows.pinyin: Zhèngrú xuézhě suǒ zhǐchū de…
rows.translation: As scholars have pointed out…

rows.source: 資料顯示，過去十年間增長了百分之四十。
rows.pinyin: Shùjù xiǎnshì, guòqù shí nián jiān zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī sìshí.
rows.translation: The data show that over the past decade it grew by 40%.

lessons.title: 是...的 emphasis
lessons.description: Highlight when, where, or how something happened

exercises.prompt: What does "她是去年從英國回來的" emphasize?
options: When and where she returned from
exercises.answer: When and where she returned from
exercises.explanation: 是...的 highlights the time (去年) and origin (從英國); the listener already knows she returned.

exercises.prompt: Build "This theory was first proposed by Einstein"
exercises.answer: 這個 理論 是 愛因斯坦 最早 提出 的

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct emphasis sentence for "It was in 1949 that the People's Republic was founded."
options: 中華人民共和國是1949年成立的
中華人民共和國1949年成立了
中華人民共和國成立1949年
中華人民共和國是1949年成立
exercises.answer: 中華人民共和國是1949年成立的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 1949 as the focused year; the other options either drop 是, drop 的, or scramble the word order.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct word: "這篇論文 ___ 王教授寫的" (focus: who wrote it)
exercises.answer: 是
exercises.explanation: 是...的 fronts "by Professor Wang" as the focus. 被 would create a passive but mismatch with 的; 把 needs a disposed object after it; 在 marks location, not agent focus.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon was first discovered in the 19th century"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 是 在 十九 世紀 首次 被 發現 的

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "她昨天回來了" into 是...的 emphasis (focus on the time):
exercises.answer: 她是昨天回來的
exercises.explanation: 是 sits before the highlighted time; 的 closes the sentence. The other options break the frame.

exercises.prompt: the 是...的 sentence to what it emphasizes
Complete with the missing 的 closer: "該理論是上世紀七十年代提出 ___"
exercises.answer: 的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 always closes with 的 — a common omission error.

exercises.prompt: Tap the focus you hear
exercises.answer: 她是從美國回來的
exercises.explanation: 美 vs 英 is a one-tone listening swap. 是...的 vs 了 changes whether the sentence is emphasis-frame or fresh report.

exercises.prompt: Build the formal academic line "This finding was published in Nature last year"
exercises.answer: 這 一 發現 是 去年 在 《 自然 》 雜誌 上 發表 的

exercises.prompt: Which version is correct emphasis for "It was Einstein who first proposed this theory"?
options: 這一理論是愛因斯坦最早提出的
愛因斯坦最早提出這一理論了
這一理論由愛因斯坦提出過
exercises.answer: 這一理論是愛因斯坦最早提出的
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames 愛因斯坦 + 最早 as the focus. The other forms either drop 是/的 or scramble word order.

lessons.title: Topic framing — 對...來說
lessons.description: Scope an argument to a population or angle

exercises.prompt: Build "For young people, housing prices are unbearable"
exercises.answer: 對 年輕人 來說 ， 房價 已經 難以 承受

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal?
exercises.answer: 對我而言
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 is the formal academic version of 對...來說; both go further than 我覺得.

exercises.prompt: the framing phrase

pairs.right: As far as students are concerned

exercises.prompt: "從長遠來看" (cóng cháng yuǎn lái kàn) means "in the ___ run"
exercises.answer: Long

exercises.prompt: Build "In terms of economic efficiency, this plan is the most reasonable"
exercises.answer: 就 經濟 效益 而言 ， 這個 方案 最為 合理

exercises.prompt: What does "就這一問題而言，學界尚未達成共識" mean?
options: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.answer: On this question, academia has not yet reached consensus
exercises.explanation: 就...而言 frames the topic; 尚未 ("not yet") is the formal version of 還沒.

exercises.prompt: the topic-framing phrase to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal academic frame: "___ 發展中國家 而言，氣候變化是巨大的挑戰"
exercises.answer: 對
exercises.explanation: 對...而言 / 就...而言 are both correct; 對 is more common.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 對學生而言，考試壓力非常大
對學生來說，考試壓力非常大
學生嘛，考試壓力對他們而言非常大
就學生而言，考試壓力非常大
exercises.answer: 學生嘛，考試壓力對他們而言非常大
exercises.explanation: 嘛 is colloquial filler; 而言 is formal. Mixing them sounds jarring. The other three are register-internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Build "In the long run, education investment will yield enormous returns"
exercises.answer: 從 長遠 來看 ， 教育 投入 將 帶來 巨大 回報

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
options: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
對年輕人來說房價已經難以承受
對老年人而言房價已經難以承受
對年輕人而言房價已經可以承受
exercises.answer: 對年輕人而言房價已經難以承受
exercises.explanation: Listening at C1: 而言/來說 is register; 年輕人/老年人 is the topic; 難以/可以 inverts polarity.

lessons.title: Citing & paraphrasing
lessons.description: Bring sources into your argument

exercises.prompt: the citation phrase
Build "The data show that population is rising year by year"
exercises.answer: 資料 表明 ， 人口 正在 逐年 上升

exercises.prompt: What does "眾所周知" (zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī) mean?
options: It is well known to all
exercises.answer: It is well known to all
exercises.explanation: Literally "what the masses all know" — a fixed academic opener.

exercises.prompt: "研究表明" (yán jiū biǎo míng) means "research ___"
exercises.answer: Shows

exercises.prompt: Tap the connective you hear
exercises.spokenText: 因此我們得出以下結論
options: 因此我們得出以下結論
由此我們得出以下結論
因為我們得出以下結論
於是我們得出以下結論
exercises.answer: 因此我們得出以下結論
exercises.explanation: 因此 ("therefore") and 由此 ("from this") both link cause to result, but 因此 fronts the conclusion while 由此 fronts the inference path. Train your ear to catch the difference.

exercises.prompt: the citation style to its function
Pick the most academic phrasing for "according to the latest research":
exercises.answer: 根據最新的研究
exercises.explanation: 根據 ("based on") + 研究 + neutral nominalization is the academic standard. The others are casual or hedged.

exercises.prompt: Build "As Professor Wang has pointed out, this view warrants further investigation"
exercises.answer: 正如 王 教授 所 指出 的 ， 這 一 觀點 值得 進一步 研究

exercises.prompt: Peer-review hedge: "該論文 ___ 一定的創新性，但論證仍可加強" (has a certain degree of)
exercises.answer: 具有
exercises.explanation: 具有/具備一定的 X 是 standard peer-review hedge — you grant a degree without overstating.

exercises.prompt: What does "該研究為後續工作奠定了基礎" mean?
options: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.answer: This research lays the foundation for follow-up work
exercises.explanation: 奠定基礎 = lay the foundation — fixed academic praise.

exercises.prompt: Build "The data show that over the past decade urbanization has accelerated significantly"
exercises.answer: 資料 表明 ， 過去 十年 間 城市化 程序 顯著 加快

lessons.title: Hedging & qualifying
lessons.description: Soften claims like a careful scholar

exercises.prompt: Which phrase hedges a generalization the most?
exercises.answer: 在一定程度上
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 ("to a certain extent") signals a partial / qualified claim.

exercises.prompt: Build "This phenomenon seems to be related to climate change"
exercises.answer: 這 一 現象 似乎 與 氣候 變化 有關

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its function
"據說" (jù shuō) introduces a claim attributed to others — "___" in English
exercises.answer: It is said

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most cautious academic claim?
options: 結果絕對證明氣候變化加速
結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
結果表明氣候變化加速
結果說明氣候變化必然加速
exercises.answer: 結果在一定程度上表明氣候變化可能加速
exercises.explanation: 在一定程度上 + 可能 stacks two hedges. 絕對/必然/必將 over-claim; 表明 alone is moderate.

exercises.prompt: Build "Generally speaking, this approach has some validity"
exercises.answer: 總的 來說 ， 這種 方法 在 一定 程度 上 是 有效 的

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its strength
Pick the near-synonym distinction:
options: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.answer: 我深信 (firm conviction) > 我認為 (current view) > 我以為 (mistaken prior)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient: 我深信 (deeply believe) > 我堅信 ≈ 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (was mistaken). Mishearing flips the message.

exercises.prompt: Tap the hedged claim you hear
exercises.spokenText: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
options: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
這一現象肯定與氣候變化有關
這一現象似乎與氣候變化無關
這一現象一定與氣候變化有關
exercises.answer: 這一現象似乎與氣候變化有關
exercises.explanation: 似乎/肯定/一定 sit at very different hedge levels. 有關/無關 inverts polarity.

exercises.prompt: Build "To a certain extent, this view has its rationale, but it still needs further verification"
exercises.answer: 在 一定 程度 上 ， 這 一 觀點 有 其 道理 ， 但 仍 需 進一步 驗證

exercises.prompt: Soften the strong claim: "該方案絕對可行" → "該方案 ___ 可行" (in a certain way)
exercises.answer: 或許
exercises.explanation: 或許/可能/似乎/在一定程度上 all soften the assertion.

lessons.title: Presenting research
lessons.description: Open, signpost, and conclude a talk

exercises.prompt: Build "Today I want to discuss three main findings"
exercises.answer: 今天 我 想 討論 三 個 主要 發現

exercises.prompt: the signpost to its function
What does "綜上所述" (zōng shàng suǒ shù) mean?
exercises.answer: To summarize the above
exercises.explanation: Standard academic transition leading into the conclusion section.

exercises.prompt: "謝謝大家，歡迎提問" closes a talk and means "thank you all, ___ for questions"
exercises.answer: Welcome

exercises.prompt: the thesis-section name to its function
Which line best opens an academic talk?
options: 今天我想跟大家分享我們最近的研究成果
我說啊，最近做了點東西
聽好了，今天講我的論文
exercises.answer: 今天我想跟大家分享我們最近的研究成果
exercises.explanation: 分享研究成果 + 跟大家 = warm but academic. The other three drift toward casual or hostile.

exercises.prompt: Build "To summarize the above, our research has three main findings"
exercises.answer: 綜上 所述 ， 我們 的 研究 有 三 個 主要 發現

exercises.prompt: Tap the closing transition you hear
exercises.spokenText: 綜上所述這一假設得到驗證
options: 綜上所述這一假設得到驗證
綜上所述這一假設遭到否定
總而言之這一假設得到驗證
總的來說這一假設得到驗證
exercises.answer: 綜上所述這一假設得到驗證
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述/總而言之/總的來說 are register-graded summarizers. 得到驗證 / 遭到否定 inverts the conclusion.

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct signpost order in a talk:
exercises.answer: 首先...其次...最後
exercises.explanation: 首先 → 其次 → 再次 (optional) → 最後 is the canonical sequence.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "由此 ___，環境保護至關重要" (we can see / it follows that)
exercises.answer: 可見
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 fronts a concluding inference. 不難看出 is a near-synonym.

exercises.prompt: Build "Thank you for listening, your questions and feedback are most welcome"
exercises.answer: 感謝 各位 的 聆聽 ， 歡迎 大家 提問 與 指正

lessons.title: 把…當作 / 視…為 — "regard X as Y"
lessons.description: Frame an entity as something else for analysis

exercises.prompt: What does "我們把語言當作一種工具" mean?
options: We treat language as a tool
exercises.answer: We treat language as a tool
exercises.explanation: 把 X 當作 Y = "take X to be Y / regard X as Y". A core academic framing.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards education as the foundation of social mobility"
exercises.answer: 這 篇 文章 把 教育 視為 社會 流動 的 基礎

exercises.prompt: the framing pattern to its register

pairs.right: Neutral, common in speech and writing

exercises.prompt: Complete the formal version: "我們 ___ 資料 視 ___ 決策的依據" (regard data as the basis for decisions)
exercises.answer: 把 為
exercises.explanation: 把/將 X 視為 Y is the formal academic frame; 把 X 當作 Y is the neutral cousin.

exercises.prompt: Build "This article regards the development of artificial intelligence as the central question of our era"
exercises.answer: 本文 將 人工 智慧 的 發展 視為 這 一 時代 的 核心 問題

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch:
options: 本文將語言視為一種社會工具
我們把語言看成一種工具
我們將語言看成一種工具唄
本研究將語言視為一種交際工具
exercises.answer: 我們將語言看成一種工具唄
exercises.explanation: 將 + 視/看成 lean formal; 唄 is a casual sentence-final particle. The other three keep register internally consistent.

exercises.prompt: Tap the framing you hear
exercises.spokenText: 我們將教育視為社會流動的基礎
options: 我們將教育視為社會流動的基礎
我們把教育當作社會流動的基礎
我們把教育看成社會流動的基礎
我們將教育看成社會流動的基礎
exercises.answer: 我們將教育視為社會流動的基礎
exercises.explanation: 將...視為 is the most formal academic register; 把...當作 is neutral; 看成 is casual.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "我們把它當成寶" into academic register: "我們 ___ 視 ___ 珍寶"
exercises.answer: 將 為

exercises.prompt: What does "該研究將文化視為一種動態結構" mean?
options: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.answer: This study regards culture as a dynamic structure
exercises.explanation: 將 X 視為 Y = treat X as Y. 動態結構 = dynamic structure.

exercises.prompt: Build "Some scholars regard climate change as the greatest challenge of the 21st century"
exercises.answer: 一些 學者 將 氣候 變化 視為 二十 一 世紀 最 大 的 挑戰

lessons.title: 由此可見 / 不難看出 — drawing inferences
lessons.description: Lead the reader to your conclusion

exercises.prompt: What does "由此可見" (yóu cǐ kě jiàn) signal in academic writing?
options: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.answer: From this we can see / it follows that
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 hands the reader a conclusion drawn from the evidence just presented.

exercises.prompt: the inference phrase

pairs.right: From this it can be seen
It is not hard to see

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that this trend will continue"
exercises.answer: 不難 看出 ， 這 一 趨勢 將 持續

exercises.prompt: Complete: "___ ，教育對經濟發展至關重要" (from this it can be seen that...)
exercises.answer: 由此可見
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 fronts a concluding inference.

exercises.prompt: Build "From this it can be seen that the demographic trend has profoundly affected the economy"
exercises.answer: 由此 可見 ， 人口 趨勢 對 經濟 產生 了 深遠 影響

exercises.prompt: Which inference signal is the most cautious?
exercises.answer: 可以認為
exercises.explanation: 可以認為 ("one can argue") softens the inference. 由此可見 is moderate; 毫無疑問 / 必然 over-claim.

exercises.prompt: Tap the inference phrase you hear
exercises.spokenText: 不難看出這一趨勢將持續
options: 不難看出這一趨勢將持續
不難看出這一趨勢將停止
由此可見這一趨勢將持續
可想而知這一趨勢將持續
exercises.answer: 不難看出這一趨勢將持續
exercises.explanation: 不難看出/由此可見/可想而知 are near-synonyms with subtle differences. 持續/停止 inverts the prediction.

exercises.prompt: the inference connector to its sense

pairs.right: From this it can be seen

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial conclusion: "___ 否認，氣候變化已成為全人類共同的挑戰" (cannot be denied)
exercises.answer: 無可
exercises.explanation: 無可否認 / 毋庸置疑 are interchangeable strong-claim openers.

exercises.prompt: Build "It is not hard to see that, faced with this challenge, the international community must cooperate further"
exercises.answer: 不難 看出 ， 面對 這 一 挑戰 ， 國際 社會 必須 進一步 合作

lessons.title: Dialogue: Thesis defense Q&A
lessons.description: Defend your methodology under formal academic scrutiny

exercises.prompt: Your committee chair is questioning your thesis methodology.

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義。
turns.spokenText: 請先簡述本研究的核心論點及其學術意義

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: State the core argument formally — use 旨在
options: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀之形塑作用。
我這篇論文就是說社交媒體怎麼影響年輕人的。
turns.answer: 本研究旨在揭示社交媒體對青年價值觀之形塑作用。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 然而你的樣本量僅有三百人，是否足以支援如此寬泛的結論？
turns.spokenText: 然而你的樣本量僅有三百人，是否足以支援如此寬泛的結論

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the formal causal frame: "the reason ... is because ..."
turns.after: 採用三百人樣本，是因為側重深度訪談而非統計推斷。
turns.answer: 之所以

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 那麼你如何回應質性研究普遍存在的主觀性問題？
turns.spokenText: 那麼你如何回應質性研究普遍存在的主觀性問題

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede then defend — pick the register-appropriate reply
options: 主觀性確實難以避免，然而本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度。
對啊主觀就主觀唄，我儘量客觀了。
嗯主觀是有點，但是沒辦法嘛。
turns.answer: 主觀性確實難以避免，然而本研究通過三角驗證以增強信度。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 三角驗證的具體操作是什麼？請舉一例。
turns.spokenText: 三角驗證的具體操作是什麼？請舉一例

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Use 其 — formal third-person possessive ("its / their")
turns.before: 訪談、問卷與日誌三者互證，
turns.answer: 其

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 理論框架方面，你為何捨棄哈貝馬斯而採用布林迪厄？
turns.spokenText: 理論框架方面，你為何捨棄哈貝馬斯而採用布林迪厄

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Justify the choice — academic register with 而
options: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯，而非公共領域之話語結構。
我覺得布林迪厄比較好用一些。
哈貝馬斯太老了所以我換了。
turns.answer: 布林迪厄之慣習概念更契合青年群體之實踐邏輯，而非公共領域之話語結構。

turns.speaker: prof
turns.text: 答辯到此。委員會將另行通知評議結果。
turns.spokenText: 答辯到此，委員會將另行通知評議結果

lessons.title: Urbanization
lessons.description: Migration, megacities, and growing pains

exercises.prompt: the term to its meaning
Build "Urbanization has brought enormous economic benefits"
exercises.answer: 城市化 給 經濟 帶來 了 巨大 的 好處

exercises.prompt: What does "大城市的房價居高不下" mean?
options: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high
Houses are cheap in big cities
exercises.answer: Big-city housing prices remain stubbornly high

topics.description: Read poems, discuss films, appreciate calligraphy

guide.intro: Classical Chinese threads through modern writing in three little words: 之, 其, 所. They look intimidating but they're not new grammar — they're compressed forms of structures you already know. Recognize them and most literary and academic Chinese opens up.

sections.text: 之 — the literary 的
之 (zhī) is what 的 used to be. In modern Chinese it survives in fixed expressions and titles. Wherever you see 之, mentally substitute 的. The structure 名詞 + 之 + 名詞 = "X's Y" or "Y of X".

rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī měi
rows.translation: The beauty of China (= 中国的美)

rows.pinyin: Chénggōng zhī dào
rows.translation: The path to success

rows.pinyin: Zǒng ér yán zhī
rows.translation: All in all ("to sum up and speak of it")

rows.pinyin: Yì jǔ liǎng dé zhī shì
rows.translation: Something that kills two birds with one stone

sections.text: 其 — "its / their / his / her"
其 (qí) is the literary third-person possessive — equivalent to 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他們的, depending on context. You'll meet it in essays, instructions, and idioms.

rows.pinyin: Qí jiéguǒ lìng rén zhènjīng.
rows.translation: Its (the) result is shocking.

rows.pinyin: Gōngsī jí qí yuángōng
rows.translation: The company and its employees

rows.pinyin: Yóuqí
rows.translation: Especially ("particularly its [case]")

rows.pinyin: Gè qǔ qí suǒ xū
rows.translation: Each takes what they need

sections.text: 所 — turning verbs into nouns

所 (suǒ) sits before a verb to nominalize the object: 所 + 動詞 = "that which is V-ed". The full pattern is often 名詞 + 所 + 動詞 + 的 + 名詞 = "the X that N V's". It feels ancient but appears constantly in titles and formal speech.

rows.pinyin: Wǒ suǒ kàndào de
rows.translation: What I have seen (literally: that which I saw)

rows.pinyin: Wǒmen suǒ zuò de nǔlì
rows.translation: The efforts we have made

rows.pinyin: Zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī
rows.translation: As is universally known

rows.pinyin: Lǐ suǒ dāng rán
rows.translation: As reason dictates / naturally

sections.text: You almost never need to write 之/其/所 yourself in everyday Chinese. The goal is recognition: when you see 其, your brain swaps in 它的; when you see 所...的, you read it as "the thing that is V-ed".

lessons.description: Genres, plots, characters

exercises.prompt: the genre
What does "這本小說情節曲折" mean?
options: This novel has a winding / twisty plot
exercises.answer: This novel has a winding / twisty plot
exercises.explanation: 曲折 = winding, turning — a positive description of an engaging plot.

exercises.prompt: Build "The hero's character is portrayed very vividly"
exercises.answer: 主人公 的 性格 刻畫 得 非常 生動

exercises.prompt: "這部作品堪稱經典" — 堪稱 means "___ to be called"
exercises.answer: Worthy
exercises.explanation: 堪稱經典 ("worthy of being called a classic") is a stock praise phrase.

exercises.prompt: the literary-criticism term
What does "這部小說意境深遠" mean?
options: The novel has a profound atmosphere / artistic conception
The novel is hard to read
exercises.answer: The novel has a profound atmosphere / artistic conception
exercises.explanation: 意境 = artistic mood / conception; 深遠 = far-reaching. Stock praise for literary work.

exercises.prompt: Build "This novel uses a multi-line narrative to portray the fate of one generation"
exercises.answer: 這 部 小說 用 多 線 敘事 描繪 了 一 代 人 的 命運

exercises.prompt: Tap the praise phrase you hear
exercises.answer: 這部作品堪稱經典
exercises.explanation: 堪稱 ("worthy of being called") vs 自稱 ("self-proclaim") vs 堪比 ("comparable to") — meanings shift sharply.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this book review:
options: 該作品意境深遠，堪稱當代文學典範
這本書超有意思，堪稱當代文學典範
這部小說語言細膩，敘事獨到
本書以平實筆觸展現了普通人的悲歡
exercises.answer: 這本書超有意思，堪稱當代文學典範
exercises.explanation: 超有意思 is colloquial slang; 堪稱典範 is formal book-review register. Mixing them sounds off.

exercises.prompt: Complete the praise: "作者筆下的人物 ___ 入微" (described down to the smallest detail)
exercises.answer: 刻畫
exercises.explanation: 刻畫入微 ("portray down to the finest detail") is a fixed praise phrase.

exercises.prompt: Build "As critics have pointed out, this work depicts the spiritual landscape of an entire era"
exercises.answer: 正如 評論家 所 指出 的 ， 該 作品 描繪 了 一 個 時代 的 精神 風貌

lessons.title: Film & cinema
lessons.description: Direct, act, review

exercises.prompt: the film term
What does "票房口碑雙豐收" mean?
options: Box office and word-of-mouth both succeed
exercises.answer: Box office and word-of-mouth both succeed
exercises.explanation: 口碑 = word-of-mouth/reputation; 雙豐收 = double harvest — high praise for a movie.

exercises.prompt: Build "This film reflects deep social issues"
exercises.answer: 這 部 電影 反映 了 深刻 的 社會 問題

exercises.prompt: "這部電影感人至深" — 感人至深 means deeply ___
exercises.answer: Moving

exercises.prompt: the film-review term
What does "導演用細膩的鏡頭語言展現了人物的內心世界" mean?

The film has too many close-ups
The director cuts the film roughly
exercises.answer: The director uses delicate cinematography to reveal the characters' inner worlds
exercises.explanation: 細膩的鏡頭語言 / 內心世界 = professional film-review register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the box office did not meet expectations, the word-of-mouth was excellent"
exercises.answer: 儘管 票房 未 達 預期 ， 然而 口碑 十分 出色

exercises.prompt: Tap the review phrase you hear
exercises.answer: 票房口碑雙豐收
exercises.explanation: 雙豐收 ("double harvest") is a fixed expression — listen for 雙/同 swap and 豐收/失敗/高峰 noun differences.

exercises.prompt: Pick the most formal film-review register:
options: 該片以詩意的影像語言探討了城市變遷中的人性
這電影拍得挺有詩意，講城市變化
片子蠻文藝的，講城市的事

exercises.explanation: 該片 + 影像語言 + 探討 + 城市變遷 = full critical-review register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the praise: "演員的演技 ___，讓觀眾身臨其境" (exquisite)
exercises.answer: 精湛

exercises.prompt: Build "This film is not only thought-provoking but also visually stunning"
exercises.answer: 這 部 電影 不僅 發人深省 ， 更 在 視覺 上 令 人 震撼

lessons.title: Classical traces — 之 / 其
lessons.description: Recognize literary leftovers in modern writing

exercises.prompt: In "中國之美", 之 functions as ___
exercises.answer: A possessive (= 的)
exercises.explanation: 之 in 中國之美 is the modifier-marker (= 的), linking 中國 to 美 — "the beauty of China".

exercises.prompt: the 之 / 其 expression
Rewrite "該書及它的譯本" in literary register: "該書及 ___ 譯本"
exercises.answer: 其
exercises.explanation: 其 = 它的 — the literary possessive used in formal writing.

exercises.prompt: What does "成功之道" mean?
exercises.answer: The path / way to success
exercises.explanation: 之 = 的; 道 = way / path.

exercises.prompt: Pick the classical-vs-modern equivalent: "它的影響" rewrites in literary register as ___
exercises.answer: 其影響
exercises.explanation: 其 = 它的 / 他的 / 她的 / 他們的 — the literary possessive.

exercises.prompt: Build "All in all, the impact of this work is far-reaching"
exercises.answer: 總而 言之 ， 這 部 作品 的 影響 極為 深遠

exercises.prompt: Convert "中國的美" into literary register: "中國 ___ 美"
exercises.answer: 之
exercises.explanation: 之 is the literary 的 — used in titles and fixed phrases.

exercises.prompt: the classical-modern equivalents
Tap the literary register you hear
exercises.answer: 其結果令人震驚
exercises.explanation: 其 vs 它的 — register; 震驚 vs 驚喜 — emotional polarity.

exercises.prompt: What does "恰如其分" describe?
exercises.answer: Exactly fitting / appropriate
exercises.explanation: 恰如 ("just like") + 其分 ("its proper portion") — used to praise judicious phrasing or measured action.

exercises.prompt: Build "This poem and its translation jointly constitute a literary classic"
exercises.answer: 這 首 詩 及 其 譯本 共同 構成 了 一 部 文學 經典

lessons.title: 所 — "that which is..."
lessons.description: Nominalization with the classical 所

exercises.prompt: What does "我所喜歡的書" mean?
exercises.answer: The book(s) that I like
exercises.explanation: 所 + verb + 的 + noun = the [noun] that [subject] [verbs].

exercises.prompt: the 所 idiom to its meaning

pairs.right: Naturally / as a matter of course

exercises.prompt: Build "What he said is exactly what I think"
exercises.answer: 他 所 說 的 正是 我 所 想 的

exercises.prompt: "理所當然" means "as ___ would have it / naturally"
exercises.answer: Reason
exercises.explanation: 理 (reason) + 所 + 當然 — "that which reason makes natural".

exercises.prompt: What does "該作者所提出的觀點引發了廣泛討論" mean?
options: The view that the author put forward sparked wide discussion
Discussion of the author's view was banned
exercises.answer: The view that the author put forward sparked wide discussion
exercises.explanation: 所提出的觀點 = "the view (that was) put forward" — 所 + 提出 + 的 nominalizes the object.

exercises.prompt: Build "What we have done is far from enough"
exercises.answer: 我們 所 做 的 遠 遠 不夠

exercises.prompt: the 所-construction to its meaning
Convert "我喜歡的書" into literary 所-style: "我 ___ 喜歡 ___ 書"
exercises.answer: 所 的
exercises.explanation: Subject + 所 + 動詞 + 的 + 名詞 — fully nominalized phrase.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 理所當然:
options: Literal: 'reason makes it natural'; Figurative: 'as a matter of course / naturally'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'reason makes it natural'; Figurative: 'as a matter of course / naturally'
exercises.explanation: 理所當然 literally parses 'that which reason makes natural'; in modern use it just means 'of course, naturally'.

exercises.prompt: Tap the 所-construction you hear
exercises.spokenText: 他所做的努力值得肯定
options: 他所做的努力值得肯定
他所做的努力值得否定
他所有的努力值得肯定

topics.title: News & journalism
topics.description: Read headlines, parse op-eds, follow current events

guide.intro: News Chinese is its own dialect — short, dense, and heavy with cause-effect connectives. Two patterns dominate explanatory writing: 之所以 X 是因为 Y for reverse-order causation, and 不仅 X 而且 Y for stacking points. Get fluent in these and headlines stop being puzzles.

sections.text: 之所以...是因為 — effect first, cause second

Standard order is 因為 X 所以 Y ("because X, so Y"). When you want to lead with the surprising effect and explain it after, flip to 之所以 Y 是因為 X ("the reason Y is because X"). It's a hallmark of essay and op-ed Chinese.

rows.source: 他之所以成功，是因為他從不放棄。
rows.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi tā cóng bù fàngqì.
rows.translation: The reason he succeeded is that he never gave up.

rows.source: 中國之所以發展迅速，是因為改革開放的政策。
rows.pinyin: Zhōngguó zhī suǒ yǐ fāzhǎn xùnsù, shì yīnwèi gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè.
rows.translation: China developed rapidly because of the reform and opening-up policy.

sections.text: 不僅...而且 — "not only... but also"
不僅 X 而且 Y stacks points: not only X, but also Y. The formal form is 不但 X 而且 Y; the literary form 不僅...更 ramps up the second clause.

rows.source: 這部電影不僅獲得了好評，而且票房火爆。
rows.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bùjǐn huòdé le hǎopíng, érqiě piàofáng huǒbào.
rows.translation: This film not only got good reviews but also did huge box office.

rows.source: 他不僅是一位作家，更是一位思想家。
rows.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn shì yí wèi zuòjiā, gèng shì yí wèi sīxiǎngjiā.
rows.translation: He is not only a writer but, even more so, a thinker.

sections.text: Headline grammar
Headlines compress hard. They drop pronouns, particles, and even verbs. Learn these high-frequency journalist verbs and you'll skim headlines in seconds.
據 X 報道 — quick refresher

You met 據報道 at B2, so this is a refresher rather than new ground. At C1, focus on the variants: 據 X 報道 attributes to a named source, while 據悉 ("it is learned") is the unsourced, slightly official cousin. Both anchor the start of a sentence.

rows.source: 據新華社報道，會議將於下週舉行。
rows.pinyin: Jù Xīnhuáshè bàodào, huìyì jiāng yú xiàzhōu jǔxíng.
rows.translation: According to Xinhua News Agency, the meeting will be held next week.

rows.source: 據悉，相關部門正在調查此事。
rows.pinyin: Jù xī, xiāngguān bùmén zhèngzài diàochá cǐ shì.
rows.translation: It is learned that the relevant departments are investigating the matter.

guide.intro: Persuasive Chinese has its own choreography: state your premise, acknowledge the counter-argument, then refute. Three structures power the dance — conditionals (要是...就/便, 即使...也), the concessive 虽然...但是, and the rhetorical 难道...吗.

sections.text: Conditionals

rows: As long as X, then Y
除非 X 否则 Y

rows.source: 要是你早點告訴我就好了。
rows.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ zǎo diǎn gàosù wǒ jiù hǎo le.
rows.translation: If only you had told me earlier.

rows.pinyin: Jíshǐ xiàyǔ, wǒmen yě yào qù.
rows.translation: Even if it rains, we are still going.

rows.translation: Unless he apologizes, I will not forgive him.

sections.text: 雖然...但是 — concede then push back
The strongest debaters concede. 雖然 X 但是 Y ("although X, but Y") signals you've heard the counterpoint and have an answer. Formal upgrade: 儘管 X，然而 Y.

rows.translation: Although costs rose, the company is nevertheless still profitable.

sections.text: 難道...嗎 — rhetorical question
難道 ("could it really be that") fronts a question to which the speaker assumes the answer is obvious. Used to challenge an assumption or rebuke.

rows.pinyin: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdào ma?
rows.translation: Could it be that you don't know? (You should know!)

rows.pinyin: Nándào zhè jiù shì dá'àn ma?
rows.translation: Is this really the answer?

sections.text: In writing, balance your concessives. A column that opens with 雖然...但是 and closes with 難道...嗎 reads as classic argumentative Chinese.

lessons.title: Stating your position
lessons.description: Open with confidence

exercises.prompt: the opener
Build "In my view, this view is one-sided"
exercises.answer: 在 我 看來 這個 觀點 比較 片面

exercises.prompt: Which is most formal for "I firmly believe"?
exercises.answer: 我堅信
exercises.explanation: All four are plausible C1 alternatives, but 堅信 ("firmly believe") is the strongest and most formal — 深信 is close behind, 相信 is neutral, 認定 leans toward "conclude / be convinced".

exercises.prompt: "毫無疑問" (háo wú yí wèn) means ___
exercises.answer: Without a doubt

exercises.prompt: Tap the verb of belief you hear
exercises.answer: 我認為這個方案可行
exercises.explanation: 認為 ("hold the view that") states a current belief; 以為 ("used to think / mistakenly thought") implies the speaker has since changed their mind. Mishearing one for the other flips the meaning.

exercises.prompt: Pick the strongest gradient ordering for verbs of belief:
options: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
我以為 > 我深信 > 我認為
我覺得 > 我深信 > 我以為
exercises.answer: 我深信 > 我堅信 > 我認為 > 我覺得 > 我以為 (mistaken)
exercises.explanation: Strength gradient runs from firm conviction to casual impression to mistaken prior view.

exercises.prompt: Build "In my humble view, this view, although appealing, is somewhat one-sided"
exercises.answer: 依 我 之 見 ， 這 一 觀點 雖 具 吸引力 ， 但 略 顯 片面

exercises.prompt: the position-marker to its register
Complete the formal opener: "在 ___ 看來，這一現象值得深思" (in our view)
exercises.answer: 我們
exercises.explanation: 在我們看來 / 在我看來 = formal opinion frame.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this debate opener:
options: 依我之見，該方案存在嚴重缺陷
依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
在我看來，這個方案存在缺陷
我認為該方案需要進一步完善
exercises.answer: 依我之見，這玩意兒壓根不行
exercises.explanation: 依我之見 is literary; 這玩意兒/壓根 are colloquial. Mixing them sounds jarring.

exercises.prompt: Tap the strength of conviction you hear
exercises.answer: 我深信這一觀點
exercises.explanation: 我深信 / 我堅信 / 我相信 / 我認為 sit at four points on the strength dial. C1 listening discriminates them.

lessons.title: Conditionals — 要是, 即使, 只要
lessons.description: Build hypothetical arguments

exercises.prompt: What does "即使下雨我們也要去" mean?
options: If it rains we won't go
Even if it rains we are still going
If it stops raining we'll go
We are going only if it rains
exercises.answer: Even if it rains we are still going

exercises.prompt: Build "As long as you work hard, you will succeed"
exercises.answer: 只要 你 努力 ， 就 一定 會 成功

exercises.prompt: the conditional
Complete: "___ 他道歉，否則我不會原諒他" (Unless...)
exercises.answer: 除非

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if there are setbacks along the way, we will not give up"
exercises.answer: 即使 途 中 遭遇 挫折 ， 我們 也 不會 放棄

exercises.prompt: What does "假如換個角度看，問題或許更清晰" mean?
options: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.answer: If we look from another angle, the problem may be clearer
exercises.explanation: 假如 = formal "should / suppose"; 或許 = soft hedge "perhaps".

exercises.prompt: the conditional to its strength
Complete: "___ 你願意傾聽，對方就會願意溝通" (As long as)
exercises.answer: 只要
exercises.explanation: 只要 X 就 Y — sufficient-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Tap the conditional you hear
exercises.spokenText: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
options: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
除非他先道歉否則我們一定讓步
只要他先道歉我們就會讓步
如果他先道歉我們就會讓步
exercises.answer: 除非他先道歉否則我們不會讓步
exercises.explanation: 除非...否則 vs 只要...就 vs 如果...就 differ in logic. C1 listening discriminates the necessary-condition frame.

exercises.prompt: Pick the formal hypothetical version of "if costs were to fall, demand would surge":
options: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
要是成本掉了，需求就會漲
成本要是下來需求肯定上去
成本下來了需求就上去
exercises.answer: 假如成本下降，需求便會激增
exercises.explanation: 假如 + 便 + 激增 = formal economic-reasoning register.

exercises.prompt: Build "Even if it takes ten years, this goal still warrants the effort"
exercises.answer: 即使 需要 十 年 ， 這個 目標 仍 值得 我們 努力

lessons.title: Concede & refute
lessons.description: 雖然...但是 / 儘管...然而

exercises.prompt: Build "Although this plan has risks, the returns are large"
exercises.answer: 雖然 這個 方案 有 風險 ， 但是 收益 很 大

exercises.prompt: Which is the most formal version of "although...however"?
exercises.answer: 儘管...然而
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 belongs in essays, news, and formal speech.

exercises.prompt: Pick the sentence that concedes a point and pushes back:
options: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面
exercises.answer: 你說得有道理，但是我們也要看到另一面

exercises.prompt: "你說得有道理" means "what you say is ___"
exercises.answer: Reasonable

exercises.prompt: Build "Although the opposing view has its rationale, we still need to see another side"
exercises.answer: 儘管 對方 的 觀點 不無 道理 ， 然而 我們 仍需 看到 另一 面

exercises.prompt: What does the rebuttal structure "誠然...然而..." express?
options: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.answer: Concede a point genuinely, then turn against it
exercises.explanation: 誠然 ("granted / it is true that") + 然而 = a debater's classic concede-and-pivot.

exercises.prompt: the rebuttal opener
Tap the concession marker you hear
exercises.spokenText: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
options: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
雖然成本上升但是公司仍然盈利
儘管成本下降然而公司仍然盈利
儘管成本上升然而公司開始虧損
exercises.answer: 儘管成本上升然而公司仍然盈利
exercises.explanation: 儘管/雖然 differ in register; 上升/下降 inverts cause; 盈利/虧損 inverts result.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch in this concede-and-rebut:
options: 儘管對方觀點有合理之處，然而問題在於其忽視了長期影響
儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
誠然，該方案有其優勢，然而風險亦不容忽視
話雖如此，仍需考慮實際操作的可行性
exercises.answer: 儘管你說的沒錯啊，但是問題在於這玩意兒沒用
exercises.explanation: 儘管 lean formal; 你說的沒錯啊 / 這玩意兒沒用 are casual. Mixed register sounds inconsistent.

exercises.prompt: Convert casual "雖然有問題但是值得嘗試" to formal: "___ 存在 不足 ， ___ 仍 值得 嘗試"
exercises.answer: 儘管 然而
exercises.explanation: 儘管...然而 is the formal upgrade of 雖然...但是.

exercises.prompt: Build "That said, we still need to consider its impact on small and medium-sized enterprises"
exercises.answer: 話 雖 如此 ， 我們 仍 需 考慮 其 對 中小 企業 的 影響

lessons.title: Rhetorical questions — 難道...嗎
lessons.description: Sharpen a point with a challenge

exercises.prompt: What does "難道你不知道嗎？" really mean?
options: A genuine question — does he/she know?
exercises.answer: An accusation — surely you know!
exercises.explanation: 難道...嗎 expects the answer "of course" or "of course not".

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "Could this really be the only solution?"
exercises.answer: 難道 這 是 唯一 的 解決 辦法 嗎

exercises.prompt: the rhetorical opener
"難道你忘了嗎？" implies you ___ have forgotten
exercises.answer: Shouldn't
exercises.explanation: Rhetorically, the speaker assumes you remember.

exercises.prompt: Build the rhetorical "If even this is not a problem, then what could possibly be a problem?"
exercises.answer: 如果 這 都 不 算 問題 ， 那 還有 什麼 算 問題 呢

exercises.prompt: What does "試問，誰能在此情況下保持冷靜？" really argue?
options: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.answer: Nobody could stay calm under such circumstances
exercises.explanation: 試問 ("I ask") fronts a rhetorical challenge. The expected answer is the negative.

exercises.prompt: the advanced rhetorical question opener
Tap the rhetorical opener you hear
exercises.spokenText: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
options: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
難道我們就這樣堅持嗎
難道你們就這樣放棄嗎
我們難道這樣放棄了嗎
exercises.answer: 難道我們就這樣放棄嗎
exercises.explanation: Listen for 我們/你們 (we/you), 放棄/堅持 (give up/persist), and word order — all classic C1 traps.

exercises.prompt: Pick the literary rhetorical "how could we possibly tolerate this?":
exercises.answer: 我們豈能容忍此事
exercises.explanation: 豈能 ("how could one possibly") + 此事 ("this matter") = literary register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the rhetorical opener: "___ 這就是事實的全部？" (could it really be that)
exercises.answer: 難道
exercises.explanation: 難道 fronts a question with an obvious-to-the-speaker answer.

exercises.prompt: Build the literary rhetorical "How could we ignore so many warnings?"
exercises.answer: 如此 多 的 警告 ， 我們 豈 能 視而 不見

lessons.title: Dialogue: Panel rebuttal — concede and push back
lessons.description: Rebut an opponent on a televised panel using concede-then-pivot tactics

exercises.prompt: On a televised debate panel, an opponent attacks your position on AI regulation.

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 您主張嚴格監管人工智慧，這豈不是扼殺創新？
turns.spokenText: 您主張嚴格監管人工智慧，這豈不是扼殺創新

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Concede the partial truth then pivot — formal register
options: 韓先生所言不無道理，然而無監管之創新，終將反噬社會。
你說的有點對啦但是不管也不行啊。
你說得對但是我還是不同意。
turns.answer: 韓先生所言不無道理，然而無監管之創新，終將反噬社會。

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 可監管措施往往滯後於技術，豈非形同虛設？
turns.spokenText: 可監管措施往往滯後於技術，豈非形同虛設

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in the 4-character idiom for "better late than never"
turns.answer: 亡羊補牢

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 您難道認為政府比工程師更瞭解技術？
turns.spokenText: 您難道認為政府比工程師更瞭解技術

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Reframe the question — use 並非 to deny the false premise
options: 我並非主張政府精通技術，而是強調公共利益須有制度保障。
我不是說政府懂技術啦我是說要管。
你扯遠了我沒說政府懂。
turns.answer: 我並非主張政府精通技術，而是強調公共利益須有制度保障。

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 可若監管過嚴，企業必將外遷，國家如何獲益？
turns.spokenText: 可若監管過嚴，企業必將外遷，國家如何獲益

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Push back using rhetorical question — 難道...嗎
options: 難道為求短期產值，便要放棄對社會的長期責任嗎？
你的意思就是賺錢最重要唄？
外遷就外遷唄有什麼了不起。
turns.answer: 難道為求短期產值，便要放棄對社會的長期責任嗎？

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 那您建議的監管框架，核心原則是什麼？
turns.spokenText: 那您建議的監管框架，核心原則是什麼

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Fill in 既然...就 — "since ... then"
turns.after: 技術影響深遠，就應以風險分級為本，重者嚴管，輕者寬鬆。
turns.answer: 既然

turns.speaker: opp
turns.text: 在此一點上，我與您所見略同。
turns.spokenText: 在此一點上，我與您所見略同

topics.title: Chéngyǔ in context
topics.description: Eight high-frequency four-character idioms used the right way

guide.intro: 成语 (chéngyǔ) are four-character idioms that compress a story or principle into one phrase. There are thousands of them, but only a few hundred are actually high-frequency. We'll meet eight that you'll see weekly in news, conversation, and writing — and learn the contexts where each lands well.

sections.text: How idioms slot into sentences

成語 typically work as adjectives, adverbs, or full predicates. Most can stand alone as a four-character verb phrase: 一舉兩得 ("two birds, one stone") can be the whole verb. Some need a 是 or 的 frame to slot in: 這是一舉兩得的事.

rows.pinyin: Zhè zhēn shì yì jǔ liǎng dé.
rows.translation: This really is killing two birds with one stone.

rows.pinyin: Tā gōngzuò bàn tú ér fèi.
rows.translation: He gave up halfway through the work.

rows.pinyin: Jǐn shàng tiān huā de shèjì
rows.translation: An icing-on-the-cake design

sections.text: Eight to remember

rows: Win-win solution / two birds, one stone
Help when help is most needed
Enter the village, follow its customs
When in Rome, do as the Romans

sections.text: 錦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
These two are taught as a pair. 錦上添花 is help when things are already good — nice but not vital. 雪中送炭 is help in a crisis — the kind people remember forever. Pick the right one when praising someone.

rows.pinyin: Nǐ zhè shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn, xièxie!
rows.translation: This is help when I really needed it — thank you!

rows.source: 不算什麼，只是錦上添花。
rows.pinyin: Bú suàn shénme, zhǐshì jǐn shàng tiān huā.
rows.translation: It's nothing, just a small bonus.

sections.text: Don't pile 成語 on top of 成語. One per paragraph in writing, one per minute in speech. Used sparingly they sound elegant; used densely they sound like a textbook.

lessons.title: Win-win — 一舉兩得
lessons.description: And its sibling 一石二鳥

exercises.prompt: What does "一舉兩得" literally mean?
exercises.answer: One action, two gains
exercises.explanation: 一舉 = one move; 兩得 = two gains.

exercises.prompt: Build "This plan is really a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 這個 方案 真是 一舉兩得

exercises.prompt: Which situation best fits "一舉兩得"?
options: Walking the dog AND getting exercise
exercises.answer: Walking the dog AND getting exercise

exercises.prompt: "一石二鳥" is the equivalent of "___ stone, two birds"
exercises.answer: One

exercises.prompt: the idiom to its classical story

pairs.right: Han-era essay: one move gains two ends
Tale of throwing one stone to fell two birds
Mencius: half the effort, double the result
Mencius: fish and bear-paw can rarely both be had

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 一舉兩得:
options: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'one lift, two gains'; Figurative: 'achieve two aims with one action'
exercises.explanation: 一舉 literally means 'one lift / one move'; 兩得 literally means 'two gains'. The modern figurative use is 'kill two birds with one stone'.

exercises.prompt: Build the headline-style "Renewable energy: economic and environmental two-birds-one-stone"
exercises.answer: 可再生 能源 ： 經濟 與 環保 一舉兩得

exercises.prompt: Complete the news context: "騎車上下班 ___，既環保又鍛鍊" (kills two birds with one stone)
exercises.answer: 一舉兩得
exercises.explanation: 一舉兩得 fits a benefit-stacking situation perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 這真是一舉兩得
exercises.explanation: All four start with 一. Listen for 舉兩得 (action, two gains) vs 無所獲 (no gain) vs 鳴驚人 (sudden fame) vs 蹴而就 (achieved at one go).

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成語:
options: 他每天跑步上班，既鍛鍊了身體又節省了交通費，真是一舉兩得
他下班後回家做飯，真是一舉兩得
他失敗了，真是一舉兩得
我們既能學習又能賺錢，可謂一舉兩得
exercises.answer: 他失敗了，真是一舉兩得
exercises.explanation: 一舉兩得 requires two positive outcomes from one action. Pairing it with simple failure is a misuse.

exercises.prompt: Build "This policy can not only stimulate the economy but also create jobs — truly a two-birds-one-stone solution"
exercises.answer: 這 項 政策 不僅 能 刺激 經濟 ， 還 能 創造 就業 ， 實 為 一舉兩得

lessons.title: Quitting halfway — 半途而廢
lessons.description: And the opposite: 堅持不懈

exercises.prompt: What does "半途而廢" describe?
exercises.answer: Giving up halfway

exercises.prompt: Build "Don't give up halfway, persistence brings success"
exercises.answer: 不要 半途而廢 ， 堅持 才 能 成功

exercises.prompt: the idiom to its meaning
"堅持不懈" — 不懈 means "without ___"
exercises.answer: Slacking

exercises.prompt: Pick the literal-vs-figurative distinction for 半途而廢:
options: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
It only has a literal meaning
It only has a figurative meaning
exercises.answer: Literal: 'on the road, halfway, then abandoned'; Figurative: 'give up halfway through'
exercises.explanation: 半途 = halfway on the road; 而廢 = and abandon. Story comes from the 禮記 tale of the wife who cuts her unfinished weaving to teach her husband not to quit study.

exercises.prompt: Build "If we give up halfway now, all our previous efforts will be in vain"
exercises.answer: 如果 現在 半途而廢 ， 之前 所有 的 努力 都 將 前功盡棄

exercises.prompt: Complete the editorial: "科研之路漫長，唯有 ___ 方能有所突破" (perseverance)
exercises.answer: 堅持不懈
exercises.explanation: 唯有 X 方能 Y = formal "only by X can one Y". 堅持不懈 fits the long-haul mission perfectly.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 他工作半途而廢
exercises.explanation: 半途而廢 (give up halfway) vs 堅持不懈 (persevere) — opposite qualities. 全力以赴 (give it all) and 前功盡棄 (waste prior effort) are different shades.

exercises.prompt: Spot the misused 成語:
options: 他攻讀博士四年，從未半途而廢
他買了菜，吃完了，真是半途而廢
專案剛到一半就停了，等於半途而廢
exercises.answer: 他買了菜，吃完了，真是半途而廢
exercises.explanation: 半途而廢 requires giving up an unfinished task. Eating bought food to completion is finishing, not abandoning halfway.

exercises.prompt: the perseverance idiom to its meaning
Build "As long as we persevere, we will surely reach our goal"
exercises.answer: 只要 我們 堅持不懈 ， 就 一定 能 達到 目標

lessons.title: 錦上添花 vs 雪中送炭
lessons.description: Bonus help vs critical help

exercises.prompt: A friend lends you money when you're broke. They are providing ___
exercises.answer: 雪中送炭
exercises.explanation: 雪中送炭 = help in a crisis — "sending charcoal in the snow".

exercises.prompt: Adding extra dessert to an already-feast is ___
exercises.answer: 錦上添花
exercises.explanation: Already-good situation + bonus = "adding flowers to brocade".

exercises.prompt: Build "What you did was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 你 這 真 是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: "錦" originally means ___ — fine brocade silk
exercises.answer: Brocade
exercises.explanation: 錦 specifically refers to brocade or patterned silk — distinct from 繡 (embroidery).

exercises.prompt: Build "At the most difficult moment, your help was truly help in time of need"
exercises.answer: 在 我 最 困難 的 時候 ， 你 的 幫助 真是 雪中送炭

exercises.prompt: Pick the right idiom: a wealthy company donates to disaster relief — bystanders praise this as ___
exercises.answer: 雪中送炭
exercises.explanation: Disaster victims are in crisis — 雪中送炭 fits. 錦上添花 would suggest the recipients were already fine.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "她已經夠優秀了，這次得獎只能算 ___" (icing on the cake)
exercises.answer: 錦上添花
exercises.explanation: 錦上添花 fits when the recipient is already in a good state.

exercises.prompt: Tap the idiom you hear
exercises.answer: 你這是雪中送炭

topics.title: Abstract & philosophical
topics.description: Talk about ideas, ethics, fate, and meaning

guide.intro: Modern Mandarin still leans on a small cluster of fate-and-cause vocabulary inherited from Confucian, Buddhist, and Daoist thought. Three words do most of the work: 缘分 (fated connection), 因果 (cause and effect), and 命运 (destiny). They aren't religious jargon — speakers use them every day to talk about relationships, outcomes, and choices. Learning the cultural framing keeps you from translating them too flatly.

sections.text: 緣分 — the right people, the right time

緣分 (yuán fèn) names the unseen tie that brings two people, or a person and a place, together. It's used loosely in romance ("we have 緣分"), friendship ("我們很有緣"), and even chance encounters. The Buddhist root is 緣 ("condition that gives rise to a meeting"); the modern register is warm, slightly fatalistic, and very common.

rows.source: 我們能再見面，真是緣分。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen néng zài jiànmiàn, zhēn shì yuán fèn.
rows.translation: That we could meet again is truly fate.

rows.pinyin: Yǒu yuán qiān lǐ lái xiāng huì.
rows.translation: If fated, even a thousand miles can't keep two from meeting.

rows.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jiù suí yuán ba.
rows.translation: Let's just let this one go where fate takes it.

sections.text: 因果 — cause and effect

因果 (yīn guǒ) literally pairs 因 (cause) with 果 (fruit / result). In Buddhist usage it names karma; in modern speech it works as a neutral "cause and effect" — useful in argument, science writing, and ethics talk alike. The four-character expression 因果報應 ("karmic retribution") keeps the moral edge.

rows.pinyin: Fán shì dōu yǒu yīn guǒ.
rows.translation: Every event has a cause and an effect.

rows.source: 我們要分析這件事的因果關係。
rows.pinyin: Wǒmen yào fēnxī zhè jiàn shì de yīn guǒ guānxi.
rows.translation: We need to analyse the causal relationship of this matter.

rows.pinyin: Zhòng shàn yīn, dé shàn guǒ.
rows.translation: Plant good causes, reap good fruits.

sections.text: 命運 — destiny you can argue with

命運 (mìng yùn) is destiny, but with more give than the English word suggests. Speakers talk about 改變命運 ("change one's destiny") and 與命運抗爭 ("struggle against fate") freely — destiny is fixed enough to name, fluid enough to push against. Adjacent terms: 天命 (heavenly mandate, more solemn), 宿命 (predetermined fate, fatalistic).

rows: Neutral; can be changed in modern usage

sections.text: These words sit in everyday conversation, not just temples. A friend who lands a job they nearly missed will say 這就是緣分; a parent reflecting on a child's path will say 改變命運. Don't over-translate them as "karma" or "fate" — let the context pick the English.

exercises.prompt: Spot the register mismatch — which sentence sounds wrong because a casual word slipped into a formal frame?
options: 鑑於市場啥的都不穩定，公司因此暫緩上市
鑑於市場近期不穩定，公司因此暫緩上市

exercises.answer: 鑑於市場啥的都不穩定，公司因此暫緩上市

exercises.prompt: What does "鑑於近期市場波動，公司因此暫緩上市" mean?
options: The company will IPO soon despite volatility
Given recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO
The company canceled the IPO permanently
The market is stable so the IPO continues
exercises.answer: Given recent market volatility, the company is therefore postponing its IPO
exercises.explanation: 鑑於 X 因此 Y is the formal causal frame; 暫緩 = postpone temporarily.

exercises.prompt: What does "眾所周知，氣候變化是全人類共同面臨的挑戰" mean?

As is well known, climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together
Climate change is a recent discovery
Climate change only affects some countries
exercises.answer: As is well known, climate change is a challenge faced by all of humanity together

exercises.prompt: Which sentence uses 是...的 emphasis?
exercises.answer: 我是去年去的北京
exercises.explanation: 是...的 frames the time (去年) as the focused element.

exercises.prompt: "任重道遠" expresses that the ___ is heavy and the road is long
exercises.answer: Burden
exercises.explanation: Used to admit a long, arduous mission ahead.

exercises.prompt: What does the editorial line "由此可見，該現象的產生有其深層原因" mean?

exercises.answer: From this it can be seen that the phenomenon has deep underlying causes
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 + 深層原因 = inference + deep cause — classic op-ed move.

lessons.title: Complements — 得 / 不 / 完 / 光 / 掉 / 破
lessons.description: Potential and result complements that fine-tune verbs

exercises.prompt: What does "這麼多菜我吃不完" mean?
options: I don't want to eat so many dishes
I can't possibly finish so many dishes
I have not eaten the dishes
I am still eating the dishes
exercises.answer: I can't possibly finish so many dishes
exercises.explanation: 吃不完 is the potential complement: V + 不 + 完 = "unable to finish V-ing". Positive form: 吃得完 ("can finish").

exercises.prompt: the result complement to its sense
Build "This wine is so good we'll definitely finish it"

options: Be able to think it through / let it go (potential complement)
exercises.answer: Be able to think it through / let it go (potential complement)
exercises.explanation: 想得開 = potential complement: 想 + 得 + 開 = able to open one's mind to it. Negative: 想不開.

lessons.title: Separable verbs — 離合詞
lessons.description: 見過面, 幫了一個忙, 結過婚

exercises.prompt: Why is "我見面他了" wrong?
options: 見面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我見過他的面 / 我跟他見過面
見面 only takes a time word
exercises.answer: 見面 is a separable verb — the object goes in the middle: 我見過他的面 / 我跟他見過面
exercises.explanation: Separable verbs (離合詞) like 見面, 幫忙, 結婚 are V-O compounds. You can't tack a second object on; aspect markers and modifiers go between the two halves.

exercises.prompt: the separable-verb form to its sense
Build "He did me a big favor yesterday"

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
exercises.answer: 我們見過兩次面
exercises.explanation: With 離合詞, the experience marker 過 follows the verb-half (見), and the count phrase splits the compound: 見過兩次面.

exercises.prompt: Build "He sang two songs at the party last night"
exercises.answer: 他 昨晚 在 派對 上 唱 了 兩 首 歌

exercises.prompt: Pick the correct separable-verb form for "I have been worried for three days":
exercises.answer: 我擔了三天心
exercises.explanation: 擔心 is a 離合詞. The duration splits between 擔 and 心: 擔了三天心.

exercises.prompt: the 離合詞 to its split form
Tap the correct separable-verb form you hear
exercises.answer: 他幫了我一個大忙
exercises.explanation: 幫 + 了 + indirect-object + 一個 + 大 + 忙 — the 離合詞 splits cleanly.

exercises.prompt: Convert "我們見面三次了" into the correct 離合詞 form: "我們見 ___ 三次面 ___"
exercises.answer: 了 了
exercises.explanation: 見過/了 + 三次 + 面 + 了 — duration splits the compound.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows correct separable-verb negation?
exercises.answer: 我沒結過婚
exercises.explanation: 沒 + 結 + 過 + 婚 — 沒 sits before the verb-half, 過 follows the verb-half.

exercises.prompt: Build "They have danced together three times"
exercises.answer: 他們 一起 跳 過 三 次 舞
